(async () => { await window.raid.fresh(); await window.raid.hold(true); return await 'a new member, clock held'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.start(11, 0); await window.raid.skip(1.2); return await 'first pick'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.taught(); await window.raid.to('boon'); return await window.raid.skip(1.5); })()

(async () => { await window.raid.skip(1.5); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.acorns(24); await window.raid.give('glorp'); await window.raid.give('glorp'); await window.raid.offer(0,'glorp'); await window.raid.item('thorn'); await window.raid.item('plume'); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await 'planning, staged for a merge and an item'; })()

(()=>{document.querySelector('#traits .trait').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerleave',{pointerType:'mouse'})); const p=window.raid.party().find(p=>p.on==='board'); window.raid.hand(0, p.id); window.raid.skip(0.8); window.raid.hover(0, p.id); window.raid.skip(0.1); return 'a second component over '+p.kind})()
(async () => { await window.raid.skip(2); await window.raid.plan(); await window.raid.skip(1); await window.raid.fight(); return await window.raid.tick(10); })()

(async () => { await window.raid.skip(3); await window.raid.carry(); await window.raid.skip(1.5); await document.querySelector("[data-pick='0']")?.click(); await window.raid.settled(); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await window.raid.last(); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.skip(9); await window.raid.to('spar'); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await 'a regular across the table'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.skip(9); await window.raid.to('boss'); await window.raid.arrive(); await window.raid.skip(1.5); return await 'the boss is on its way in'; })()
(async () => { await window.raid.fight(); await window.raid.tick(40); return await window.raid.busy(400); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.tick(3000); await window.raid.skip(10); await window.raid.to('end'); await window.raid.skip(4); return await JSON.stringify(window.raid.state().mode); })()
(async () => { await window.raid.skip(1); await window.raid.to('front'); await window.raid.skip(0.2); return await 'the front page with a raid laid out'; })()
